cells.gaps: No register of payers is established: the systems are described as collection modules and point-of-sale receipting, and a taxpayer database appears only as a feature of a proposed system. The 70% (33 of 47) is of 2020 and includes partial automation; the newest fact on coverage, of February 2026, names 5 of 47 counties as well established and 6 as largely manual, and does not say what is recorded. The July 2026 standards say counties are to own their systems and data, while an October 2026 commentary puts about 70 per cent of counties on contracts paying a vendor a share of collections; no source says any county has complied.
cells.note: More than half of counties had automated collection, held in vendor-hosted systems, but what is recorded is receipts. Receipts alone stop at stage 3; stage 4 needs a register.
